notes.title: Update 6.60 released
notes.content:
The patch version 6.60 (and 6.59) has been released.

[u][b]Patch notes:[/b][/u]

Main corrections and improvements:

-Adjustment of economic impact after covid pandemy on deficit and unemployment for specific countries (v6.60)

-Correction on the centering of the minimap
-Initialization of the popularity of the Republican and Democrats candidates for the US presidential election according to the results observed in reality
-Adjusting the importance of the second wave of the Covid-19 epidemic
-Adjusting the speed of scientific discovery algorithm for AI countries
-Correction of the TV Breaking News for the "Coronation" scenario in German
-Taking into account in the calculation of the level of Human Rights (democracy / dictatorship) of the levels of Freedom from the Culture menu, of the freedom of education, of the budget for the National Youth Movement (especially useful for accession to the European Union)
-Correction of growth rates following certain discoveries (anti-sleep pill for example)
-Correction on the cost of national military service
- Addition of Georgian first and last names
-Removed the impact of exceptional revenue earned with the God’n’Spy on the Head of State’s popularity and loyalty with other characters
-Correction on the departure request of foreign troops present on its soil
-Correction on Media infrastructure after an annexation
-Delay in the construction of refugee camps following the attack on the city by ground units
-Correction of the number of mercenaries when creating a mod with modification of a terrorist organization
-Allowing  barges of military units to merge
-Fixed display of scandal when attempting to reveal
-Correction on the cancellation of the construction of a space rocket launching base
-Taking into account the actions of the head of state in the calculation of his alignment with international stars
-Adjustment of public revenue following customs duties
-Adjustment on Wealth Tax revenue 
-Modification so that zone bombings do not affect hidden illegal camps 
-Update the price of poultry for a number of countries
-Adjustment of CO2 emissions worldwide without Covid from 2021
-Adjusted growth calculation on future mods
-Various corrections

We would like to thank the entire community and beta testers for their collaboration in improving the game. 

If you encounter any bugs or inaccuracies in the game, or if you have suggestions for improvements, do not hesitate to contact us: on support@power-and-revolution.com (technical problems) or on contact@power-and-revolution.com (other problems or suggestions)
